weaknesses: The abstract could better clarify the significance of the Polyak–Łojasiewicz condition in the context of the results presented.
The paper does not sufficiently address potential limitations of the proposed approach, particularly regarding the assumptions made about the activation functions.
strengths: The theoretical contribution of linking deep residual networks to neural ODEs is original and significant.
The paper provides a rigorous mathematical framework that enhances the understanding of implicit regularization in deep learning.
Numerical experiments effectively illustrate the theoretical findings, providing empirical support for the claims made.
